name: Smoked Salmon, Herb Cream Cheese & Cucumber Sandwich
instructions: Cut cream cheese into small pieces. Place in a small bowl.
Wash, dry, and chop chives into small pieces. Add to the bowl with the cream cheese along with dill and pepper. Using the back of a spoon, mash and combine the herb cream cheese. Set aside.
Wash, dry, trim, and peel cucumber; slice crosswise into thin rounds.

Place bread on a flat surface. Divide the herb cream cheese between the slices and spread out in an even layer. Layer half of the slices with cucumber and salmon, then close sandwiches with remaining slices of bread.
To serve, slice sandwiches in half and divide between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
